about_the_game:
Re - Fracture : The Prophet's Awakening is a Traversal themed RPG where momentum is your greatest weapon. As Shaiden Wreath, you will master Shadow-based abilities allowing you to chain together aerial manoeuvres, teleport past obstacles, and uncover the truth behind the Collapse, and your missing brother, Siege.

A Traversal-Heavy RPG complemented by Dynamic Combat and a Robust Dialogue System, Re - Fracture offers players a high-speed, fluid movement system where every rooftop, ledge, and wall is part of the playground.

Leap between towering buildings, execute seamless teleports, and outmanoeuvre foes in a world built for movement.

Key Features:

  • Fluid Traversal System – Surge, blink, and warp effortlessly through an interconnected city, mastering movement-based abilities like Phantom Vault and Phantom Reach to navigate obstacles.

  • Fast-Paced Combat (In Development) – Strike with Shadow Slashes, phase through enemy attacks, and chain together warps for devastating finishers.

  • Engaging Story & Dialogue – Unravel the mystery of Siege and the Collapse through dynamic dialogue and world interactions.

  • Exploration & Side Activities – Challenge yourself with Time Trial Races, test your skills in environmental puzzles, or dive into Drifta’s underground rap scene in a unique rhythm-based mini-game.

Traverse the unknown, master the shadows, and define your own path in Project: Contrast.
